payload.body: Implemented live ObjectUpsert authorization parity: sync gateway now runs baseline -> app policy hooks -> per-record write-grant relaxation before persistence. Added frame-handler regression coverage proving denied writes do not persist and valid write grants still relax eligible denials. Updated contract + changelog. Local evidence: cargo test -p frick-server gateway::tests (33/33), focused regression pass, cargo clippy -p frick-server --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo fmt --check.
